remainingFindings.summary: API-key rotation does not verify the stored key row is bound to the loaded service-principal row before deriving the replacement key tenant from that principal.
remainingFindings.details: packages/convex/confect/headless/apiKeys.impl.ts:980-1008 selects the key by the caller-selected Brain scope, then loads servicePrincipals by key.principalId and passes that principal to rotateBrainApiKey without checking principal.id, organizationId, workspaceId, brainKey, roleCeiling, status/revokedAt, and generation against the selected key. rotateBrainApiKey in headless/auth.ts derives the new key organizationId/workspaceId/brainKey from the principal, so a corrupted or mismatched principal binding can mint the rotated key outside the admin caller's selected Brain despite the tenant-scoped key lookup. Authentication has exact binding checks, but rotate/revoke management paths need the same tenant/principal invariant before mutating or creating API-key state.
